classification: Repeated audit-source reseal with unchanged v5 economic settings; not new unseen evidence

selection.classification: Training selection only; validation/confirmation have not been used. A positive training PF is not forward or native proof.

openEnd.rule: exact: the orders the engine executed in the run and still open at its end (every gate, cap and Block volume applied), marked to market at the last close

caps.source: balance-volume defaults (no balance caps in the settings)

stages.basis: unit-net-returns after one modeled round trip

entryAdmission.scope: First rejection only; candidate diagnostics may include endpoint marks. Config sets, candidate events and funded settled closes have different denominators. Never subtract these counts as though they were all sets or all closes.

notes: Base range rows are pair-level representative evidence, not counts or PF of every configured TP/SL cell.
Validation PF pools only configs passing their own recorded configEval. Seated PF uses that step's actual Real IDs too.
Historical validation windows overlap across steps and configurations; never sum them as distinct executed orders.
Execution contains only funded modeled settled closes after Base, own config validation, entry context and execution filters. It is not venue-owned execution.
The baseline all-config capital requirement is infeasible. This audit does not certify live sizing or profitability.
No-loss rows have no finite measured PF; the existing qualifying gate uses score 4. Empty/unknown cohorts remain unavailable.
